subject: info-intr
title: INFO.INTR.------TR.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 120 (T(AF)M-24). INFO-INTR (information interpretation) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; TR (transformation) is the partner. From the subject: C-CONT (composite continuance) and C-CULT-AT (composite culture attitude). From C-CONT: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and MT-IF-DB (multi-informational degree basis). From C-CULT-AT: INT (intention). From MT-IF-DB: LANG-DY (language dynamics) and LK-IMP (linkage implications). From INT: CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions).
